mapper.insert: INSERT INTO local_client_public_capability_states( ) VALUES (#{clientInstanceId}, #{activeCommit}, #{activeDigest}, #{pendingCommit}, #{pendingDigest}, #{status}, #{errorCode}, #{reportedAt}, #{updatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (client_instance_id) DO UPDATE SET active_commit=EXCLUDED.active_commit, active_digest=EXCLUDED.active_digest, pending_commit=EXCLUDED.pending_commit, pending_digest=EXCLUDED.pending_digest, status=EXCLUDED.status, error_code=EXCLUDED.error_code, reported_at=EXCLUDED.reported_at, updated_at=EXCLUDED.updated_at WHERE local_client_public_capability_states.reported_at <= EXCLUDED.reported_at

INSERT INTO local_client_public_capability_states( client_instance_id, active_commit, active_digest, pending_commit, pending_digest, status, error_code, reported_at, updated_at) SELECT client_instance_id, public_capability_commit, public_capability_digest, CASE WHEN public_capability_digest = #{bundleDigest} THEN NULL ELSE #{sourceCommit} END, CASE WHEN public_capability_digest = #{bundleDigest} THEN NULL ELSE #{bundleDigest} END, CASE WHEN public_capability_digest = #{bundleDigest} THEN 'CURRENT' ELSE 'UPDATE_AVAILABLE' END, NULL, #{observedAt}, #{observedAt} FROM local_client_instances WHERE #{capabilityName} = ANY(string_to_array(self_update_capabilities, ',')) ON CONFLICT (client_instance_id) DO UPDATE SET pending_commit=CASE WHEN local_client_public_capability_states.active_digest = #{bundleDigest} THEN NULL ELSE EXCLUDED.pending_commit END, pending_digest=CASE WHEN local_client_public_capability_states.active_digest = #{bundleDigest} THEN NULL ELSE EXCLUDED.pending_digest END, status=CASE WHEN local_client_public_capability_states.active_digest = #{bundleDigest} THEN 'CURRENT' ELSE 'UPDATE_AVAILABLE' END, error_code=NULL, updated_at=EXCLUDED.updated_at WHERE local_client_public_capability_states.pending_digest IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.pending_digest
